text:
Hey everyone! 👋🏻

Quick question: which banks would you recommend for someone with a B1 visa?

Also, could someone explain how credit cards work here? I’ve heard of people receiving credit cards with different credit limits, but when my boyfriend called a bank today, they told him that because I’m not a citizen, I wouldn’t be able to get a credit card and would only be eligible for a debit card. I’d love to hear about your experiences.

On another note, after a long year of paperwork and bureaucracy, I finally received my visa! 🎉✨

Thank you so much to everyone in this group for all the advice, recommendations, and support throughout the process. It truly helped me a lot. 🙏🏻

I’m originally from Ecuador 🇪🇨, and I’m also happy to share that I found a job shortly after receiving my visa.

If anyone is currently going through the visa process and has questions, feel free to send me a message. I’d be happy to share my experience and help if I can. 😊

And if you’d simply like to connect, don’t hesitate to reach out! ✨

Thank you again! ❤️
